prose_changes.old: Its see of Nisibis passed into the Church of the East, and it is also a parent of the Syriac Orthodox Church. Their translators later carried Greek philosophy and medicine into Arabic. From there, that learning came back to Europe.

prose_changes.old: The Assyrian Church of the East, the Syriac Orthodox Church, and the Eastern Catholic churches in communion with Rome all descend from this tradition, still worship in Syriac, and still sing Ephrem's hymns in their own liturgies.
